court_reasoning: In view of the fact that against the order of termination the delinquent availed departmental appeal to the DIG, after the order of the learned single Judge no further appeal by way of special appeal before the Division Bench would lie.

holding: The Division Bench of the High Court dismissed the special appeal on the ground of maintainability.
